targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.thingId == "org.stepnoe:Truck_01" and r._field == "value_weight_properties_value")
  |> group(columns: ["thingId", "_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> yield(name: "weight")

from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.thingId == "org.stepnoe:Truck_02" and r._field == "value_weight_properties_value")
  |> group(columns: ["thingId", "_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> yield(name: "weight")

from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.thingId == "org.stepnoe:Rail_Siding" and r._field == "value_loaded_properties_value")
  |> group(columns: ["thingId", "_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> yield(name: "loaded")

from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.thingId == "org.stepnoe:Rail_Siding" and r._field == "value_shipped_properties_value")
  |> group(columns: ["thingId", "_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> yield(name: "shipped")

description: Stepnoe fictional iron-ore mine. Synthetic telemetry via MQTT -> Ditto -> Telegraf -> InfluxDB. Dry-tonne basis; opening inventory 3000 t. 3D scene uses a local Canvas renderer, not a compiled Unity scene.
